contracts: (SnapshotBoundaryTests discovers and passes the policy-binding immutability case and full suite remains green.) AND (The build selector is discovered and manifest/content exclusion assertions pass.) AND (The cache selector is discovered and manifest/content exclusion assertions pass.) AND (The exact S2 active-Attempt selector has nonzero discovery and proves the inputs remain available and unchanged after each required action.) AND (The exact S2 cleanup-action selector has nonzero discovery and verifies an identifying audit record.) AND (The exact S2 expiry-action selector has nonzero discovery and verifies an identifying audit record.) AND (The exact S2 pin-action selector has nonzero discovery and records the required 30-day profile.) AND (The exact targeted selector is discovered with nonzero count and proves first-version bytes unchanged after second-version and ID-reuse attempts.) AND (The link selector is discovered and verifies both no target access and no target publication.) AND (The targeted SnapshotBoundaryTests GDD-inclusion selector is discovered and verifies retained Snapshot content.) AND (The targeted SnapshotBoundaryTests module-inclusion selector is discovered and verifies retained Snapshot content.) AND (The targeted SnapshotBoundaryTests secret-exclusion selector is discovered and verifies retained Snapshot content and manifest exclusion.) AND (The targeted SnapshotBoundaryTests temporary-ticket-exclusion selector is discovered and verifies retained Snapshot content and manifest exclusion.) AND (The targeted selector is discovered and observes typed rejection with no new Snapshot record.) AND (测试发现首个Snapshot策略绑定字节保持不变且后续版本正确采用新策略。) AND (版本1和版本2独立存在且不可变，ID复用请求未改变任一既有版本。) AND (首个Manifest前后字节完全一致，且复用ID未产生覆盖。)
selector_intents: PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests SnapshotVersionsRemainImmutable：创建两个版本后提交已有ID复用请求并检查冲突响应及既有版本字节不变
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests creates a post-change Snapshot and fails if its manifest lacks the active policy version, records an older version, or changes after a later policy update.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests verifies that secret fixture values are absent from produced Snapshot content and manifest.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests verifies that supported persistent GDD fixture data is retained in Snapshot output.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests verifies that supported persistent module fixture data is retained in Snapshot output.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests verifies that temporary ticket fixture values are absent from produced Snapshot content and manifest.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests 历史Snapshot策略绑定不可变：重启和策略变更后比较首个Snapshot策略绑定字节并验证新策略仅用于后续版本
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests 首个Snapshot Manifest完整性：创建第二版本和ID复用后比较首个Manifest原始字节
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests.SnapshotBoundary_DoesNotTraverseLinks invokes the real Snapshot entrypoint and asserts link targets are not accessed or included.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests.Snapshot_ExcludesBuildContent invokes the production Snapshot service and asserts build entries are absent from manifest and content.
PhaseB.Repair.SnapshotBoundaryTests.Snapshot_ExcludesCacheContent invokes the production Snapshot service and asserts cache entries are absent from manifest and content.
Run the Snapshot boundary selector that submits a user-over-quota Snapshot request and asserts rejection before persistence.
